# CANDIDATE: EXIT_PARAM_SWEEP_v14v15_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adjusting exit parameters (stop loss and take-profit levels) for different signal quality tiers can improve edge capture by allowing winners to run further while limiting losses on losing trades. The overnight_grinder sweep identified this combo as a top performer by increasing super_tp1 to 0.75 and tightening level_stop to -0.12, aiming to capture more of the 5/04 winner while avoiding losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains unchanged from the base v14/v15 strategy: BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger fires on level rejection with EMA ribbon flip and confluence. Exit logic uses quality-tiered parameters:
- SUPER quality: stop = -15%, TP1 = +75%
- LEVEL quality: stop = -12%, TP1 = +30% (with level_qty=18 contracts)
- TRENDLINE quality: stop = -6%
Runner target = 3.0x (trailing chandelier stop activated after TP1). All other exits (chart stop, time stop, catastrophe caps) unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=18 requires ~$25K+ account (per risk-rules.md position sizing: $10K–$25K = 10 contracts, $25K+ = 15+ contracts). $1K paper account would realize ~12% of headline P&L (18 contracts vs 3-contract minimum at $1K).
2. **Sample bias:** overnight_grinder tested 432 combos over ~16 months (2025-01 to 2026-06) with no walk-forward separation. High overfit risk: top keeper selected from noise distribution; edge_capture=670.6 < OP-16 floor of 771 (50% of max 1542) indicates likely overfit.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS test performed; overnight_grinder is pure in-sample sweep).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (overnight_grinder uses BS-sim pricing; real OPRA fills may differ significantly, especially for ITM/OTM 0DTE options).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/04 captures only 670.6 of 730 available winner P&L (-$59.4 vs baseline)
   - Max drawdown: overnight_grinder output shows max_drawdown=4701.52 (from stage1 run artifact)
   - Blow-up scenario: tight level_stop (-12%) could whip-saw in choppy markets, increasing trade frequency and slippage losses.
6. **Concentration:** top5_pct=1.067 (106.7%) indicates extreme concentration: top 5 days produce >100% of total P&L, implying ordinary days net lose. Quarter_pnl shows 2026-Q1 and Q2 driving profits (3977.66 + 2612.25 = 6589.91 of 6688.35 wide_pnl).
